Title: Solar Oven
Content: Winslow learns that a solar oven converts solar energy into thermal energy, which can be used to cook food. She places a bowl of uncooked pasta and water into a solar oven, as in the diagram below.

Winslow notices that after a few `text(hours)`, the pasta remains uncooked inside the oven. She wonders which changes can be made to the solar oven to better cook the pasta, so plans to refine its design. Winslow bases her design on multiple criteria and constraints.

:ibox:`1`. The design must be sturdy.
`2`. The design will work using only sunlight.
`3`. The outer body of the solar oven must act as an insulator.
`4`. The inner surface of the solar oven must absorb sufficient heat.
`5`. The reflector must allow the sunlight to reach the food item.
`6`. The adjusting rod must be moveable so that the reflector can be set according to the position of the sun.
